semanticOwner: Profiles keeps canonical AB structure and bank geometry checks; the Infrastructure adapter returns their typed result plus existing native metadata issues; the Application classifier selects exactly one captured published AB candidate from retained structure and bank facts without rereading FWConfig or using Number as artifact identity.
terminalContract: For an immutable captured AB Base, evaluate each exact published dynamic candidate once. A unique trusted AB structural proof keeps AB classification and existing typed bank/native issues, even when one or both Backups are damaged. Without structural proof, only two valid canonical bank facts that each satisfy the existing exact-capacity Standard FlashCode classifier retain terminal AB with a structural issue. Multiple candidates with equal AB evidence return terminal input.bank-reference.ambiguous; no AB evidence permits the existing Standard/Unknown fallback. NumberToken never determines detected kind. Keep NT51929/NT51951 single-candidate recognition, stale publication checks, canonical 512 KiB bank boundaries and the 1 MiB tail behavior unchanged. Do not change Profiles validators, profiles, CRC, expected bytes, or release support.
